moments.author: Roger Denny
moments.quote: We were told that Ole Miss explored every avenue… this decision isn’t fair to our athletes, our institution or to Sooner nation.
moments.why: Oklahoma AD blasting SEC commissioner for forcing Ole Miss–Oklahoma game to Sunday despite their objection has fans fired up.
moments.url: SEC moves No. 19 Ole Miss-Oklahoma game to Sunday, Sooners' AD rips decision by Sankey

moments.author: SpaceX / SPACE.com via X
moments.quote: Starship Flight 15 reached orbit but the booster catch was aborted and diverted to the Gulf.
moments.why: SpaceX’s ambitious booster‑catch attempt failed dramatically, lighting up tech and space threads among men 25–45.
moments.url: SpaceX’s Starship soars into orbit after booster explosion prevents an unprecedented double catch

moments.author: Ross Dellenger
moments.quote: GAME UPDATE: The @OleMissFB at @OU_Football game has been moved to Sunday, Nov. 15 at 1 PM ET / Noon CT due to travel issues.
moments.why: A game‑time shift due to FAA chaos is dominating college football chatter, especially among SEC fans.
moments.url: Ross Dellenger tweet about Ole Miss‑Oklahoma move

moments.author: Adam Schefter via ESPNNFL
moments.quote: The #Eagles are releasing veteran OT Fred Johnson, source says.
moments.why: A surprising NFL roster move got instant reaction from Eagles fans and fantasy–football communities.
moments.url: NFL on ESPN retweet of Adam Schefter: Eagles releasing OT Fred Johnson
